attribution: Expected release from verified deployment log; before/after built asset URLs checked. No runtime revision endpoint asserted.
limitations: Simulated Lighthouse navigation lab measurements on shared CI hardware, not field p75 or physical-device measurements.
TBT is a lab diagnostic, not measured INP. Field CWV acceptance remains open.
Fresh browser profiles; server/CDN caches may be warm. Browser/version/config captured per run.
Read-only page navigation; no forms, database writes, indexing, ads or deployment.
A successful workflow means all audits executed, not that all performance targets passed.
Desktop and unchanged article also measured faster; cannot attribute all timing changes to P1-05e. Shared runner/network/CDN variance remains.
CI public GET/browser measurement passed; earlier workspace-only 403 cause remains unresolved, not proof of all-client availability.
No new screenshot/design acceptance, PHP test or deployment claim for this read-only package.
